page.layout: One page: heading INDEX. centred at top; below it two columns of index entries (left column and right column, read top to bottom); a centred section letter in each column (W., X., Z.); centred FINIS. near the lower middle. No running head, no page number, no margin notes beyond scattered marks.

main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.l: Vitia vino concepta sine vino durant 66
Vlysses filium Telemachum ab aucupio & piscatione abstinet 72

page.notes: The first letters of W, X and Z are large decorative initials. Several entries are heavily italicised in the print; the page numbers at the far right are kept with their lines. Some marks in the left margin and on the scan are stains and show-through, not transcribed. The entries "Vlysses filium... aucupio &" and "piscatione abstinet" form one entry split across the columns. Printed "Wein Juden" appears in black letter and the printed "Wellerus" and "Widebramus" were read with uncertainty; marked where needed.
